notes.title: Mega patch!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Since we last checked in we've working on our most important game patch to date. Arcade Sundown is now available in Polish, German, Turkish, Portuguese, and Spanish!

We're so excited for more people to be able to play in their local language 🙌

And just in time for November's highly questionable weather choices, we have released a new level called 🌴🦩 Panic in Paradise 🦩🌴

Featuring:
🌋 Lava (mmm... warrrm)
🐐 Goat, mid-abduction
👽 Alien character (name is Norman, loves tight shorts)
🍹 Tiki bar, obvs

In this patch we've also made it easier to invite a Steam friend to Remote Play with you. Press the new button in the main menu to make it happen and stir up some some ruckus together! 👯

Lastly, for the righteous competitors out there, we have new Achievements up for grabs. Do you identify as a Goal Digger? A Multiplier Menace? A Leaderboard All-star? Go get 'em!

notes.title: Our game's new name and profile: Arcade Sundown!
notes.notes:
Allo Steam friends! Relatively big news: we changed our game's name! Fenderball is now Arcade Sundown 🏜️🌚👊🎮✨

The rebrand is fitting because we have evolved our game loop quite a lot. Now the pinball influence is much stronger and the focus is a wicked single-player experience. You’re competing against the high score of each machine — like in the IRL arcade days of old. But don't be concerned, you will still be able to call your friends over for extremely fun and ruckus local multiplayer sessions. That continues to be a backbone of the game :) 

We hope you enjoy the trailer we made to celebrate this occasion! Can't wait for you all to play. 

Want to chat with us? Join us over on Discord https://discord.com/invite/ghkqymE58S 

https://youtu.be/aMnEmPD_bWE

notes.title: We've been working on our game loop! ➰➰➰
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8Qoi990Fbxs;full][/previewyoutube]

The Fenderball game loop has gotten a makeover since you saw it last ☝️ 

One of the big motivators for us in re-visiting how Fenderball should flow and work as a game was that we wanted as many people as possible to play and join the community around it. That was tricky to achieve when the experience was revolving so much around a local multiplayer set up. This loop opens up a universe where single players across the world can compete with each other for the high score. 

Now the battle is on for points, rather than goals alone. A match lasts 2 minutes and 30 seconds — the highest scorer at the end of the match wins. A points multiplier introduces chaos, which you can use to pull off dark-horse wins and stratospheric scores. 

Right now we're pouring ourselves into further development. We'll continue to share more here, and we'd love for you to follow along! And please do wishlist, that makes us really happy ❤️

notes.notes:

You'll use three controls Fenderball, Dash (A), Grab (X), and Roll (RT). 

Your aim is to score goals! The goals are the illuminated fenders — your goal is the color of your character. 
 
Need any help or want to chat with us? Come on over to [url=https://discord.com/invite/ghkqymE58S]the Fenderball Discord[/url].

notes.title: The Fenderball demo is here!
notes.notes:
With Steam Sports Fest right around the corner, we thought we'd start dialing up the vibes by releasing our demo early! 

New to us and Fenderball? A recent article by Escapist Magazine summed us up pretty freaking gloriously: 

[i]The Fully Arcade is an independent developer based in Gothenburg, Sweden, and Fenderball is its first game. With a stated goal of creating a game that encourages screaming and trash-talking amongst friends, Fenderball is a multiplayer party game for up to four players. It has a retro 1980s look and feel to it in its color palette and presentation, which makes it stand out even more.[/i]

Read [url=https://www.escapistmagazine.com/fenderball-pinball-soccer-game-demo-steam/]the full article here[/url]. 

We hope our demo can get in front of a lot of sporty-inclined people throughout Sports Fest starting Monday, so wishlists matter a whole lot. Please do wishlist if you're seeing this and digging what you're seeing 🙌
